intent: Health-profile editor and coach-memory detail page prototypes for user approval. No application code changes.
data_notice: All nickname, health values, dates, habits and restrictions are illustrative mock data, not the user's account.

interaction_notes.health_profile: Unified nickname and health form, optional information collapsed, safe bottom save/cancel actions.
interaction_notes.coach_memory: Read-only categorized memories with stale indication; changes are reported via the existing coach conversation, no standalone memory CRUD implied.

concepts.title: 健康档案｜编辑界面
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity native mobile UI design prototype, one full-bleed portrait iPhone screen, approximately 1024 x 2176 proportions.
Input images: Image 1 is ONLY the approved Profile landing screen STYLE REFERENCE, not an edit target. Generate a new detail screen belonging to the same app 称小二. Carry over its typography, rounded shapes, colors and icon style, NOT its landing-page content.
Visual language: warm near-white #FBF9F6 canvas, navy #14204C type, indigo #4B588E and #303E79, apricot #FBC098, peach #FFE5D5, lavender #EEEFFC, powder blue #E0EFF8, pale gold #FFF0C2, orange #CE4E09, muted slate #73798B. White softly rounded cards, very subtle shadows, thin quiet dividers, readable simplified-Chinese native sans-serif, calm hierarchy and practical touch targets. Colorful small icon patches, not loud multicolored full backgrounds.
Shell for BOTH detail screens: real iOS status bar "18:50", with safe space beneath it; a slim native navigation header with a comfortable back-chevron button at left and the screen title in navy. These are nested screens opened from 我的, so NO four-tab bottom navigation and NO extra large brand header or app icon repeated above the form/list. No redundant giant page title, no enormous avatar, no splash/hero illustration. Bottom action area is fixed above the home indicator, with safe-area padding and generous easy-to-tap buttons; never tuck Save/Cancel into the status-bar corners. Keyboard is CLOSED in this prototype.
All example profile data and memory content is illustrative mock data, NOT the user's account. No new clinical claims, body scores, calories, membership, medals, speculative charts or medical diagnoses. No device frame, external annotation, comparison collage, watermark or debug gear. Crisp accurate Chinese copy, clean realistic shippable UI layout.
Primary request: design the HEALTH PROFILE EDIT screen reached by the combined avatar/profile-card pencil on the approved landing page. Include nickname editing within this unified editing experience. Screen title exactly "编辑健康档案". Focus on editable fields, not large read-only metric numbers.
Layout:
1. Directly below the compact navigation header, one small muted sentence "让教练了解现在的你。", NOT a large multi-line headline.
2. WHITE rounded card headed "基本资料", with a small peach person-outline icon.
   First row: label "称呼", visibly editable pale field containing "小林".
   Next row: two balanced side-by-side fields: "年龄段" with "30–39 岁" and a small dropdown chevron, and "身高" with "170" and a quiet "cm" suffix. These are input controls, not statistics. Age is a range selector, NOT exact age/birthday.
3. WHITE rounded card headed "体重与目标", with a small lavender scale/flag outline icon.
   Compact label "使用目标", then three radio-like rounded chips on one row: "减重" SELECTED in lavender/indigo, "维持体重" and "改善习惯" unselected neutral.
   Two side-by-side proper input fields, each with its label above: "当前体重" containing "79.0" plus kg suffix; "目标体重" containing "73.0" plus kg suffix. Native-sized inputs with soft lavender tint or thin borders. Do NOT turn them into giant dashboard metric typography.
   Beneath them two compact date-picker controls with calendar icons: "体重测量日期" value "2026/10/29" and "目标日期" value "2026/12/28". Can be two columns if labels and dates remain readable. Associate the dates unmistakably with their respective current/target values.
4. A compact WHITE rounded collapsed disclosure row "补充信息" with a small quiet "选填" badge and down-chevron, subtitle "体脂率、运动习惯". Optional fields remain behind this disclosure to keep the essential editing screen short; do not invent gender, phone editing or other profile fields. No optional value is set to fake zero.
5. Quiet small explanatory line "目标由你设定，可随时调整。"
6. Fixed bottom WHITE/near-white safe-area action tray with two large 48–52pt buttons: a narrower soft-lavender "取消" button and a wider INDIGO "保存修改" button with WHITE text. These buttons are easy to reach with a thumb, clearly outside the scrollable form body. Comfortable bottom safe area and black home indicator.
Composition: all essential fields and optional collapsed row visible in one viewport, normal readable font sizes, no cramped full-page questionnaire and no arbitrary decorative empty banner. Required fields and selected states are clear, but not a page of asterisks or error messages. Preserve the approved warm, gentle, non-pushy tone.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity native mobile UI design prototype, one full-bleed portrait iPhone screen, approximately 1024 x 2176 proportions.
Input images: Image 1 is ONLY the approved Profile landing screen STYLE REFERENCE, not an edit target. Generate a new detail screen belonging to the same app 称小二. Carry over its typography, rounded shapes, colors and icon style, NOT its landing-page content.
Visual language: warm near-white #FBF9F6 canvas, navy #14204C type, indigo #4B588E and #303E79, apricot #FBC098, peach #FFE5D5, lavender #EEEFFC, powder blue #E0EFF8, pale gold #FFF0C2, orange #CE4E09, muted slate #73798B. White softly rounded cards, very subtle shadows, thin quiet dividers, readable simplified-Chinese native sans-serif, calm hierarchy and practical touch targets. Colorful small icon patches, not loud multicolored full backgrounds.
Shell for BOTH detail screens: real iOS status bar "18:50", with safe space beneath it; a slim native navigation header with a comfortable back-chevron button at left and the screen title in navy. These are nested screens opened from 我的, so NO four-tab bottom navigation and NO extra large brand header or app icon repeated above the form/list. No redundant giant page title, no enormous avatar, no splash/hero illustration. Bottom action area is fixed above the home indicator, with safe-area padding and generous easy-to-tap buttons; never tuck Save/Cancel into the status-bar corners. Keyboard is CLOSED in this prototype.
All example profile data and memory content is illustrative mock data, NOT the user's account. No new clinical claims, body scores, calories, membership, medals, speculative charts or medical diagnoses. No device frame, external annotation, comparison collage, watermark or debug gear. Crisp accurate Chinese copy, clean realistic shippable UI layout.
Primary request: design the READABLE COACH MEMORY DETAIL screen opened from "教练记住的你". Native navigation title exactly "教练记住的你", back button at left, optional small muted "4 条" at right. Keep this distinct from a health form: read-only categorized memory cards and a clear conversation-based update action.
Current supported behavior: view saved memories of user goals, habits/preferences and constraints, show a stale memory as "待确认", and open the existing coach conversation to report changes. There is NO standalone direct memory CRUD interface; DO NOT draw pencil/trash icons, inline editing inputs, delete-all, fabricated source quotes, exact chat citations, AI analysis or invented confirmation-success controls.
Layout:
1. Under navigation, a small soft-lavender info strip with a quiet chat/memory outline and copy "来自你告诉教练的信息，有变化随时更新。" This is a short contextual note, not a huge doctor/avatar hero.
2. Compact filter chips "全部" SELECTED, "目标", "习惯偏好", "限制". Indigo selected text on lavender, unselected calm slate, no crowded badges.
3. Section "你的目标": a WHITE rounded card with a small pale-gold flag icon, muted label "目标体重", clear navy value "73 kg", and secondary "希望在 12月28日前达到". This is a saved user goal, not a medical recommendation or predicted result.
4. Section "习惯与偏好": one WHITE rounded grouped card with two rows and thin divider:
   - lavender cutlery outline, small label "饮食偏好", main text "喜欢清淡口味";
   - powder-blue walking outline, small label "运动偏好", main text "喜欢饭后散步".
   Do not add timestamps or word-for-word chat quotes; only human-readable saved facts.
5. Section "需要留意": one WHITE rounded card with peach shield outline, small label "饮食限制", text "暂时避免辛辣食物". At right a small soft-peach badge "待确认", plus muted small line "这项信息可能有变化，需要再确认。". It is an illustrative past user-reported preference flagged stale, NOT advice from the app. No one-tap confirmed state mutation.
6. A quiet note "以上内容用于个性化交流，不是诊断结论。" in muted slate if space permits.
7. Fixed bottom action tray with a single large INDIGO button, a small outline chat icon, and exact label "告诉教练有变化". Small helper text "进入对话，告诉教练哪些内容变了" immediately above the button or in the tray, not a second CTA. Action opens a chat, it does not imply that edits have already been saved. Respect safe-area spacing and black home indicator.
Make all four memory entries and bottom action visible without tiny text. Keep sections compact, calm, useful; match the approved Profile page closely. No four-tab navigation bar on this nested view.
